[NDET.1.4.1] **Admission carries between releases while what it measured is
unchanged.** A release row's double arithmetic may rest on evidence measured
against an earlier release's archive for that row, instead of the archive it
ships, when all of these are the same in both archives:

- the row's toolchain and the flags it compiles libds with;
- the pin of each library the row's double arithmetic rests on ([IARC.7.10],
  [IARC.7.14]), and that library's compiled objects, byte for byte;
- the set of helper functions the row's link takes for double arithmetic.

The release build must derive that helper set from the link of the archive the
row ships, at every release, whether or not the row's evidence carries; a
helper outside the set the evidence measured voids the carry. The release build
must refuse a row whose evidence was neither measured against the archive it
ships nor carries under this clause.
